Resolves #19663

Content-sized grids now pre-render nearby wrapped-text cells and horizontally unmounted height drivers in their own style scope. Native layout observations feed the existing per-view geometry and anchored height mutation; unseen rows use a pixel-rounded measured mean, while known heights stay exact. Font arrival invalidates pending replies, measures the nearby window under the new font, then replaces heights and the mean in one anchored mutation while the old geometry stays rendered. Measurement stays bounded to the nearby range, with no periodic whole-Store sweep.

Evidence: L3 native browser layout, font arrival, wheel visibility and idle-traffic controls, plus CI-covered units. The integrated 10k journey, abrupt-jump correction and final-row acceptance remain separate; Residual-Owner: #19666. Related: #19658, #19662, #19664, #19665.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Outside-CI: `PremeasureRowsNL.spec.mjs` compares the same record's hidden/displayed HTML, width and text height at 213.5px. |
| AC-2 | Outside-CI: the same spec moves the text column beyond the mounted column range and checks visible row heights against its hidden native boxes. |
| AC-3 | Outside-CI: used and unused font arrivals are sampled per animation frame with no estimate-only frame; a real `FontFace` retires a previously visited offscreen height and wheel re-entry measures it anew. CI-covered `PremeasureRows.spec.mjs` rejects held font/width replies; `main/DomEvents.spec.mjs` covers document isolation and listener teardown. |
| AC-4 | Outside-CI: 5,000-row forward/reverse × paced/32ms input witnesses report first-mounted and first-visible separately. Each proves a height was unknown before input and that the record became visible; counts are below. |
| AC-5 | CI-covered: `RowGeometry.spec.mjs` mean bookkeeping and `PremeasureRows.spec.mjs` exact-known/rounded-unseen separation, thumb hold/release and Store replacement. |
| AC-6 | Outside-CI: 60 idle animation frames preserve viewport/extent and observe zero `getLayoutRect` calls and zero renderer `updated` events; a real reset first proves both counters receive production traffic. |

## Deltas from ticket

The author's revised six-AC body incorporates the [browser-witness disposition](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19663#issuecomment-6133453286): visible rows are the wheel outcome, buffered mounts are reported separately, and idle sweeping is removed. The sampler compares actual row height with its natural wrapped-text height across bodies; the test-only DOM attribute and its repaint clause are retired. The fractional-width witness also required the header Toolbar's static-width parser to retain fractions (`parseFloat`); its owner acknowledged that seam.

## Contract Ledger

| Surface | Authority and behavior | Edge / evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Hidden Body subtree / Row text projection | View owns bounded contexts outside the physical pool; Row normalizes declared text; real body/row/cell ancestry and column widths provide the layout box. | Editors/component cells are excluded. Native parity/offscreen specs; pending-reply and replacement units. |
| `RowGeometry.measuredMean` / `hasHeight` | Record-keyed observations; constant-time mean bookkeeping; the View refines only unseen heights through `#changeRowHeights`. | Store replacement clears prior observations; exact-known and minimum-height controls. |
| `fontChange` main → App → View | `DomEvents` emits the current document/window; App publishes the event. Matching Views reject old replies and retain rendered geometry until a fresh bounded batch replaces heights and mean atomically. | Supplied non-text geometry is preserved. Missing FontFaceSet keeps the available-font behavior; listeners are released on destroy. Native arrival, supplied-height and Main units. |

## Test Evidence

Outside-CI native receipt at `d71c3bd943`: `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT=<absolute Brain checkout> NEO_E2E_RUN_ID=19663-final-hidden-pause-receipt npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs` over `PremeasureRowsNL`, `WrapTextMeasure`, `RowGeometry`, `AnchorCorrection` and `AnimateRowsContentSized`, `--workers=1 --headed` — 25 passed, zero skipped/flaky, 76.1s. Full integrated unit run: 5065 passed, 2 skipped.

CI caught an overbroad initial font invalidation: supplied synthetic heights were cleared in non-wrapping grids. The red-first control reproduced 240px becoming the 40px floor; the text-driver fence now preserves that geometry, and the older geometry/anchor/animation contracts pass. The width witness now completes the resize owner's width-plus-inline-style mutation with the Toolbar geometry-publication step. Its prior incomplete mutation could leave body cells at their old width despite a correctly updated header.

| Input | First-mounted natural-height mismatches / total | First-visible natural-height mismatches / total |
|---|---:|---:|
| Reverse, settled steps | 0 / 51 | 0 / 51 |
| Reverse, 32ms cadence | 0 / 51 | 0 / 51 |
| Forward, settled steps | 0 / 51 | 0 / 51 |
| Forward, 32ms cadence | 66 / 91 | 0 / 51 |

These are bounded visibility/coverage observations, not the integrated 10k throughput benchmark. Abrupt `scrollByRows` navigation intermittently failed to display its requested record in the font setup; this is recorded separately with #19666 rather than presented as passing navigation evidence. The final font control uses ordinary wheel input to isolate invalidation.

The original font-reset behavior is mutation-checked: both native frame witnesses fail at 32px, and the unit retention control fails 85→40. Repaired thumb release swaps the ready font heights/mean together. One integrated unit run captured foreign `cmp-scroll-1` watchdogs in loading-console spies; the unchanged-head rerun passed all 5059 tests, and the affected spec passed 6/6 alone. No unrelated implementation was changed. The subsequent normal integration of #19695 preserves its shown-cell fence alongside the generation and cache checks. A mounted grid with no layout box publishes no hidden batch; zero-width font replies wait for the next layout rather than scheduling a retry loop. The hidden-font native red control observed 267 repeated batches, repaired to zero; showing the grid automatically resumes a real batch. The final head passes 5065 units (2 skipped) and all 25 native cases.

`agent-preflight`: not hosted in Engine. Local commit/push guards and the code-line guard passed; shared baseline CI follows PR creation.

### 🪜 Strategic-Fit Decision

Per §9 Strategic-Fit Step-Back:

That defect sits in this PR's own font path, so it is an in-place repair, not a follow-up. The second action is contract drift.

**Peer-Review Opening:** Thank you, Euclid. This is the right L3: native layout in the grid's own style scope, the existing batched `getLayoutRect`, the measurement held to the nearby window with no idle sweep, and the mean folded in through `#changeRowHeights` as we agreed. The receipts are unusually honest about what CI does and does not run. Two items below, one of them visible to users.

---

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** #19663 as amended on 2026-10-12 (six ACs, idle sweep removed, quiet-idle AC). D#19645's graduated design: a `visibility: hidden` subtree in the grid DOM, no general service, existing primitives, and font arrival invalidating. `dev`'s `grid.View` (`measureRowHeights`, `#changeRowHeights`), `Body`, `Row` and `RowGeometry`. #19664 (the anchored mutation seam). A prior-art sweep: three `query_raw_memories` calls on hidden pre-render, font invalidation and premeasure; they found the D#19645 rulings and nothing contrary.
*   **Expected Solution Shape:**
  - The View owns a hidden projection inside each body, so it shares that body's style scope and column widths, rendered through `Row`'s normalization and read through the same batched `getLayoutRect` behind a generation fence.
  - The mean refines inside `#changeRowHeights`.
  - Font arrival re-measures without disturbing what is on screen.
  - Must not hardcode: fonts, widths, or a whole-store sweep.
  - Test isolation: native contracts in a real browser, plus unit specs for fences and mean bookkeeping.
*   **Patch Verdict:** It matches on the projection, the fences, the bounded window and the mean. It contradicts one point: font arrival calls `resetRowHeights`, which clears every height and the estimate before anything is re-measured, so the screen collapses for a frame (RA-1).
*   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres with verify-before-assert: the native receipts separate first-mounted from first-visible, and the PR body keeps outside-CI evidence apart from CI evidence. Coheres with the two-hemisphere organism: the font signal crosses main → App as a document event, not as a Body concern.

### 🧠 Graph Ingestion Notes

*   **`[KB_GAP]`**: A `document.fonts` `loadingdone` fires for any face of the document. That includes icon fonts and lazily loaded `unicode-range` subsets, so a consumer that resets on it resets on traffic it does not depend on.
*   **`[TOOLING_GAP]`**: Specs that mention `neuralLink` leave PR CI entirely, and grid unit specs carry `NEO_TEST_SKIP_CI` guards. An AC table therefore has to say which tier runs each row. This PR does; two of mine did not, and I am correcting them.
*   **`[RETROSPECTIVE]`**: The hidden projection lives inside each body, so it inherits that body's style scope. It sits outside the row pool and is fenced by generation, record revision and column signature. Measuring stays native without a service.
